witness.quote: A vehicle passing around a rotary traffic island shall be driven only to the right of such island.
witness.reason: The circulation intent and rotary-island geometry directly support an active passage, subject to realizing the route.
required_context: A motor vehicle within NRS 484A.320 and a driver in actual physical control.
A traversable route passing around that island, with passage beginning and end identified.
Establish vehicle classification and driver actual physical control.
Identified rotary traffic island with surveyed physical extent.
Identify the rotary traffic island and its physical extent without assuming that every roundabout or traffic island is equivalent.
Preserve the undefined rotary-traffic-island term; do not import channelized approaches, yield control or an independent counterclockwise-travel requirement.
Retain position, footprint, heading, actual travel direction and island-relative geometry throughout passage.
Supply a traversable circulation route and identify passage beginning and end.
witness.subject_reason: The available motor_vehicle_driver can control a motor vehicle within the statutory vehicle scope.
